SELECT cr.chatroom_no AS chatRoomNo, cr.chatroom_name AS chatRoomName, (SELECT content FROM ( SELECT content FROM chatting c WHERE c.chatroom_no = cr.chatroom_no ORDER BY c.send_date DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1 ) AS lastMessage, (SELECT CASE WHEN TRUNC(send_date) = TRUNC(SYSDATE) THEN TO_CHAR(send_date, 'AM HH24:MI') ELSE TO_CHAR(send_date, 'MM.DD') END FROM ( SELECT send_date FROM chatting c WHERE c.chatroom_no = cr.chatroom_no ORDER BY c.send_date DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1 ) AS lastTime,
(SELECT MAX(c.send_date) FROM chatting c WHERE c.chatroom_no = cr.chatroom_no ) AS lastSendDate FROM CHATPARTICIPANT cp JOIN CHATROOM cr ON cp.chatroom_no = cr.chatroom_no WHERE cp.participant_no = #{userNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY lastSendDate DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT c.chatting_no AS chattingNo, c.content, c.send_user AS sendUser, TO_CHAR(c.send_date, 'AM HH:MI', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=KOREAN') AS sendDate, c.chatroom_no AS chatRoomNo, u.user_name AS sendUserName FROM chatting c LEFT JOIN users u ON c.send_user = u.user_no WHERE c.CHATROOM_NO = #{chatRoomNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY c.SEND_DATE ASC

mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT r.chatroom_no AS chatRoomNo, r.chatroom_name AS chatRoomName FROM chatroom r JOIN chatparticipant p1 ON r.chatroom_no = p1.chatroom_no JOIN chatparticipant p2 ON r.chatroom_no = p2.chatroom_no JOIN users u ON p2.participant_no = u.user_no WHERE p1.participant_no = #{userNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND p2.participant_no != #{userNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND u.company_no = #{companyNo} AND u.user_name LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR r.chatroom_name LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
